info.name: Dharm API
info.description:
Dharm food rescue API – WeMakeDevs Environmental Hack 2026.

Before running:
1. Select the 'Dharm Local' or 'Dharm AWS' environment.
2. Set BASE_URL in the environment to your API root.
   Local (sam local):  http://localhost:3000
   Deployed AWS:       https://<api-id>.execute-api.<region>.amazonaws.com/dev

Endpoints are grouped by resource. Run the Health request first to confirm the API is reachable.

request.description: Liveness check. Expects HTTP 200 with { success: true, data: { status: 'ok', ... } }. No authentication required.

variable.description: Override with your deployed API base URL
